objectives.completed01: Objective completed. Recognize this small win before moving on to the next thing.
objectives.completed02: You achieved what you set out to do. That result also deserves to be part of how you evaluate your day.
objectives.improving01: You have been completing a greater proportion of your objectives. There seems to be progress in how you are moving forward.
objectives.declining01: You have completed fewer objectives recently. It may help to lower the pressure or make the next objective simpler and more concrete.
objectives.consistent01: You have maintained good consistency with your objectives. Regularity may matter more than trying to do everything.

impulse.first01: You used Impulse for the first time. This record can help us understand which strategies work best for you during intense moments.
impulse.used01: You paused and used Impulse when you needed it. That pause alone gives us useful information about how you are responding to the situation.
impulse.effective01: Impulse seems to have helped reduce the intensity. It is worth remembering what you did during that moment.
impulse.effective02: There are signs that this strategy helped you. We can begin learning which tools work best for you.
impulse.partial01: The intensity decreased a little. The strategy may have helped partially — and that is useful information for deciding what to adjust.
impulse.notEffective01: This time Impulse does not seem to have reduced the intensity. That does not mean you did anything wrong; it simply gives us more information about what may or may not help in this kind of moment.

pattern.detected01: I am beginning to find a repeated relationship in your records. It is a pattern to observe, not a definite conclusion.
pattern.improving01: One of the patterns you have been tracking seems to be moving in a positive direction. Keep observing whether this change continues.
pattern.difficult01: One of the patterns you have recorded seems to coincide with more difficult moments. We can keep observing it before drawing conclusions.

milestone.01: You have reached a new milestone. It is worth recognizing how far you have already come.
milestone.02: Another milestone reached. Progress is also made through the accumulation of these small moments.
milestone.personalBest01: This is one of your best records so far. Take a moment to notice what may have contributed to it.

special.noData01: I do not have enough data to know your rhythm well yet. Keep recording naturally and we will begin to find it.
special.multipleSignals01: Several things are happening at the same time in your records. Rather than reaching a quick conclusion, I will keep observing how these signals relate.

dailyCheckIn.stableCalm01: Even on a more balanced day, slowing down can make sense. Give yourself a moment without demands and let the pace ease a little.
dailyCheckIn.highCalm01: You're in a positive moment and still looking for calm. Use that stability to slow down without losing what is going well.
dailyCheckIn.stableMind01: You may not need to sort everything out at once. Choose the thought taking up the most space and start only with that.
dailyCheckIn.highMind01: You're in a good moment to organise what's on your mind. It may help to notice what you want to keep and what you can let go of.
dailyCheckIn.stableEnergy01: If you're looking for a little more energy, start with one small, concrete action. Movement can help create the next step.
dailyCheckIn.highEnergy01: There's already a good foundation today. Use that energy for one small thing you'd genuinely like to move forward.
dailyCheckIn.stableSupport01: Even when the day feels relatively steady, wanting company makes sense. You don't have to wait for a difficult moment to seek connection.
dailyCheckIn.highSupport01: Feeling well can be shared too. This might be a good moment to connect with someone whose company you enjoy.
dailyCheckIn.lowWell01: Today may feel harder, so keeping well might simply mean protecting what is still helping you. You don't need to do more than that right now.
dailyCheckIn.stableWell01: There seems to be some balance today. Notice what is contributing to it and try to give it room to continue.
dailyCheckIn.highWell01: Today seems to be going well. Notice what is contributing to this moment and carry a little of it with you through the rest of the day.
